title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Lakish
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Tosefta Sanhedrin, chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Sanhedrin.1.3). The name should read Rabbi Yehudah ben Lakish, as in Zuckermandel's Tosefta. So too in the [Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Sanhedrin.1b.7) and the [Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Sanhedrin.1.5.1) on [Sanhedrin 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.6b.12), and in the [Sheiltot, Mishpatim](https://www.sefaria.org/Sheiltot_d'Rav_Achai_Gaon.58.1).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Tosefta reads Rabbi Yehoshua ben Lakish. The parallel in Sanhedrin names Resh Lakish. Hyman cites Zuckermandel for Rabbi Yehudah ben Lakish, the name in [Heilprin’s separate entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1660&lang=en).
The Rif, Rosh, Sheiltot, and [the Jerusalem Talmud parallel](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sanhedrin.1.1.27) all read Rabbi Yehudah ben Lakish.
